leadText:
(Japanese: ワンダーボヤージュ Wonder Voyage) is the eighth arc of that will begin airing on May 22, 2026 in Japan. It follows the Rising Again arc. The key visual features Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult, alongside a new companion with a named Navi. The visual also includes illustrations reminiscent of , , , and , as well as Legendary Pokémon from that have yet to make physical appearances in the series. It was first announced on April 17, 2026.

The arc's opening theme is Connect the World performed by Liko (CV: Minori Suzuki) & Roy (CV: Yuka Terasaki)., and the ending theme is CUTIE SPHERE performed by Cutie Street.
